About the Delta Force Random Kit

Delta Force Random Kit is a loadout randomiser for Delta Force's Operations extraction mode. Hit Spin all to roll a full random kit: one of 17 operators, a map, a primary weapon or sidearm, and a helmet, armour vest, chest rig and backpack. Lock any slot with Hold and reroll the rest, set the tier range for each piece of gear, and turn off weapon classes, maps or operators you don't want.

Operators and weapons are shuffled so you see every option before anything repeats. Roll a difficulty (Easy, Normal or Hard) and a weapon mod budget to make each raid a challenge. The page also shows today's door codes for Zero Dam, Layali Grove, Brakkesh, Space City, Tide Prison and AZ3 Nuclear Plant, refreshed every few minutes.

Updated for Season 11 Reorientation, including N-Two, Rover, Vlinder and Morse, the AZ3 Nuclear Plant map, and new weapons such as the MDR, Thompson, RM277, AR-57, SVCH and M82.

Fan-made tool. Not affiliated with Team Jade or TiMi Studio Group. Original Random Force by Shotski · random-force.corke.dev
